description: Purchase an object another avatar listed for sale on the current lot. Prerequisite: you are NOT the owner of the target object (handler-side gate rejects own-object; own-object must use place-from-inventory or move-object instead). The object must be flagged ForSale and not in a pending transaction. Effect: money transfers from you to the owner; the object moves into your inventory (same path as send-to-inventory). Cost: the object's list price from your budget. Wire: VMNetAsyncSaleCmd on the lot Aries socket.
call_signatures: cf $CF buy-listed-object --target_object_persist_id <pid>                                             # visitor path — fails if you OWN the object
common_mistakes: OWN the object → ok:false ('cannot buy their own object') — this is the visitor path; use place-from-inventory/move-object for your own stuff.
perception_hints: Your balance (can you afford the object?): perception.balance
Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — owner-only ops refuse otherwise
Free tile to place on: inspect perception.nearby_objects[] to find unoccupied tiles; positions are in tile coords, multiply by 16 for subtile x/y
refuse_conditions: object not found in local VM → ok:false
caller OWNS the object → ok:false with 'cannot buy their own object'
